At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For water & utilities teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Water & utilities: where a pilot could start
  01: Incident communications
  02: Repair coordination
  03: Contractor close-out

Our water & utilities page puts it like this: “Link incident records, field-team updates and customer notices to the same case. The operator directs network response and authorises public updates.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
